title: `brew doctor` advisories resolved
result: `goplaces` 0.4.3 formula keg was dead weight (the binary belongs to the 0.4.9 cask), uninstalled; Homebrew autoremoved an orphaned `unbound` 1.26.0 in the same command (`brew install unbound` restores it). `terraform` 1.5.7 was an orphaned keg of a formula Homebrew removed (BUSL); no `.tf` file under `~/p` and no state file, so it was replaced with `hashicorp/tap/terraform` 1.16.1. `pillow` and `pydantic` are left unlinked deliberately: dependency kegs of `img2pdf` and `ocrmypdf`, which run from their own virtualenvs; `brew link --dry-run` shows linking would write PIL and pydantic into the global `/opt/homebrew/lib/python3.13/site-packages`. Re-check only if a dependent breaks.
